content.comment_body: Hello everyone, is it possible to change the sequence in which parameters are displayed?

Parameters are organized by block number. You can limit which parameters are shown by enabling security for specific blocks you want hidden. Alternatively, you could create a custom menu to display only selected parameters.
Thank you [user_name], but if I set up a menu, changing values directly isn't possible. It seems editing is only available in Set Parameters, such as for a Calendar.
All parameters can be changed in the user program, except for those related to weekly and yearly clocks. See attached example.

I've also faced this issue with all such Smart Relay devices. The simplest solution is to set up the app parameters in the required order from the start. This needs to be planned in advance and isn't always practical.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to customize how parameters appear in the product interface, but discover that order is tied to block number and can only be set during design. Dynamic adjustments aren't possible, and suggested workarounds like custom menus are limiting, especially for clock-related or set-parameter use cases. There's agreement that planned ordering offers some control, but flexibility is restricted for Smart Relay-type devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to freely reorder parameters during runtime with minimal redesign effort. They also want editable parameter menus and access to all parameter-related functionality, regardless of type.
